user_prompt:
A piece of wood was 40 cm long.

It was cut into 3 pieces.

The lengths in cm are

2x − 5

x + 7

x + 6

A. What is the length of the longest piece?

Answer: ____ cm

B. Show your work. If you use a calculator, you still must describe all the steps you used to obtain your answer.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer:
A. 15 cm

B. The three pieces add up to 40 cm:
\((2x-5)+(x+7)+(x+6)=40\)
\(4x+8=40\), so \(4x=32\) and \(x=8\).
The piece lengths are \(2(8)-5=11\) cm, \(8+7=15\) cm, and \(8+6=14\) cm. The longest piece is 15 cm.
